newsitem.title: USA: Ergo Science says CEO Warren Huff resigns.
newsitem.headline: Ergo Science says CEO Warren Huff resigns.

text.p: Ergo Science Corp said on Friday its Chief Executive Officer Warren Huff had resigned to pursue other interests and Ronald Abrahams, the company's Chief Operating Officer, had been named acting CEO.
Abrahams had directed clinical trials of ERGOSET, Ergo Science's lead product candidate for treatment of Type II diabetes and obesity, the company said in a statement.
"Moving ahead, the company will be best served by leadership with pharmaceutical industry background," Huff said in a statement.

Abrahams, who has a Ph.D. in pharmacology and experimental therapeutics, joined Ergo Science as a senior vice president of scientific affairs in 1994. Before that, he was a corporate vice president at Baxter International Inc.
Ergo Chairman Manuel Cincotta said an outside committee would choose a permanent CEO but Abrahams would be a leading candidate for the position.
Ergo Science also said in a separate action its board of directors elected David Castaldi, former president of BioSurface Technologies Inc, as a member.
